title: Girls' creature and hospital being were the same
summary: James Fox tells of Girls' creature and hospital being were the same, about January 1996 at Varginha, Brazil, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the capture occurred. It had to be the same being.

plain: A researcher named James Fox, on Jesse Michels' podcast, discusses events in the Brazilian town of Varginha in January 1996, where girls said they saw a strange creature and a being was reportedly captured and taken to a hospital. Fox, citing a witness named Italo Venturelli, says the creature the girls saw and the being at the hospital had to be one and the same. If true, it would tie the sighting directly to a capture of a living non-human creature.
